name: workflow-engine
notes: Kotlin/Spring Boot 4.1, Java 25, Gradle. make dev starts compose Postgres on 127.0.0.1:55434 then bootRun. DATABASE_URL is JDBC form. Swagger at /docs, spec at /openapi.json. Auth is the X-User header; RBAC grants come from workflow.rbac.grants in application.yaml (stub until the central rbac service). Tests use Testcontainers (Docker required).
